title: What Does a Fiery Broncos Practice Reveal About Bo Nix and Jaylen Waddle? | Orange & Blue Today
text: Jaylen Waddle was back out there making plays for Bo Nix, and the offense had juice — but Wednesday’s practice turned into one of the chippiest sessions of camp. The defense kept stacking wins, the offense refused to back down, and Nix himself was mixing it up in the scrums, showing the competitive edge coaches love. The Broncos defense won the day, flying around, creating pressure, and setting the tone physically. But the offense didn’t fold — they fought back, literally and figuratively, with Waddle sparking plays and Nix showing leadership in the middle of the chaos. It was intense. It was emotional.
